sources.title: Oriental Pearl TV Tower Shanghai Guide (2026): Tickets, Views & Attractions
sources.content:
The Oriental Pearl TV Tower stands at 468 meters in Shanghai's Lujiazui district. It combines sightseeing, fine dining, shopping, historical exhibitions, river cruises, and broadcasting services.

Address: No. 1 Century Avenue, Lujiazui, Pudong. Hours: 9:00 AM–9:00 PM (last entry 8:00 PM). Light Shows: 7:30 PM, 8:30 PM, 9:30 PM. Visit Duration: Approximately 3 hours.

Two-Sphere Observation Ticket: Adults 199 RMB, Children 99 RMB (under 6 or 1-1.3m), Seniors 119 RMB (70+), Free for children under 1 meter. Three-Sphere Combined Ticket (includes Space Capsule): Adults 299 RMB, Children 199 RMB.

Key Attractions: 351-Meter Space Capsule with 360-degree views. 263-Meter Main Observation Deck with floor-to-ceiling glass walls. 259-Meter Transparent Skywalk made entirely of glass. 95-Meter VR Roller Coaster. 90-Meter Outdoor Viewing Platform. 78-Meter Ascending Shanghai Show. Ground Level Shanghai Urban History Development Museum.

Dining: 267-Meter Revolving Restaurant lunch buffet 368 RMB, dinner 418 RMB. Coca-Cola Joyful Restaurant from 128 RMB. Old Shanghai No. 8 Restaurant.

Stroller Policy: Available for free near Gate 1, 200 RMB deposit. Luggage Storage available. Oriental Pearl Plaza and 0-meter lobby open to public for free.

Transportation: Metro Lines 2 or 14 to Lujiazui Station, Exit 2. Bus Routes 81 or 993.

sources.title: The Oriental Pearl Tower: Views, Tips & Things to Do
sources.content:
The Oriental Pearl Tower stands at 468 meters tall and is one of Shanghai's most famous landmarks. Hours: 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM (last entry 8:00 PM).

Second Sphere combo: 199 RMB. Children (1m-1.3m): 90 RMB. Under 1 meter: Free.

Observation Decks: 351m Space Capsule (three-sphere ticket only), 263m Observation Deck, 259m Transparent Glass Corridor (one of the coolest spots with glass floor), 90m Outdoor Observation Deck.

Sky Rotating Restaurant at 267m offers 360-degree view. Revolving Buffet (includes tower entry): 368-418 RMB.

Shanghai History Museum at base features over 80 exhibits documenting the city's development, with priceless historical artifacts, miniature models and wax figures.

Recommended visit duration: 2-3 hours. Arrive around 4-5 PM to catch the gorgeous sunset and evening illuminations.

Subway: Lines 2 or 14, exit at Lujiazui Station (Exit 2). Parking: 15 yuan/hour.

sources.title: Oriental Pearl Tower In Shanghai: Travel Tips & FAQs 2026
sources.content:
Standing at 468 meters tall, the tower offers spectacular views of Shanghai's skyline, the Huangpu River, and the historic Bund. Completed in 1994, it has come to symbolize China's modernization.

The easiest way to reach the tower is by Metro Line 2 or Line 14. Get off at Lujiazui Station.

Open from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, last entry at 8:00 PM. To fully enjoy everything, set aside 2 to 3 hours.

Double Sphere Ticket (¥199) includes access to two main observation levels. Triple Sphere Ticket (¥299) takes you all the way to the top. Buying tickets online in advance is highly recommended for discounts and to skip long lines.

Visitors recommend going around 5 PM to enjoy both the sunset and the night lights.

sources.title: Oriental Pearl Tower, Shanghai's Iconic Landmark 2026
sources.content:
The Oriental Pearl Tower opened on October 1, 1994 and stands 468 meters tall. It is a national AAAAA-level tourism attraction.

Main observation areas: 351m Space Capsule, 263m Main Observation Deck, 259m Transparent Skywalk (glass floor), 95m VR Roller Coaster, 90m Outdoor Platform, 78m Ascending Shanghai multimedia show.

Observation A ticket: 220 yuan (Space Capsule + Upper Sphere + Lower Sphere + Museum). Observation B ticket: 160 yuan (Upper Sphere + Lower Sphere + Museum).

Best visit time: early morning for fewer crowds. White day and nighttime offer different scenery experiences. Suggested visit: 2-3 hours.

sources.title: 东方明珠广播电视塔_百度百科
sources.content:
东方明珠广播电视塔位于上海市浦东新区陆家嘴世纪大道1号，投用时间1994年10月1日，总高468米，总建筑面积约100,000平方米，景点级别AAAAA级。

主体为多筒结构，由3根斜撑、3根立柱及广场、塔座、下球体、5个小球体、上球体、太空舱、发射天线桅杆等构成。

历史：1991年7月30日正式奠基开工，1994年10月1日正式竣工。1995年被评为上海十大新景观之一。2007年被批准为国家AAAAA级旅游景区。2024年9月29日迎来第一亿名游客。

建筑结构：下球体直径50米，中心标高93米，共4层。上球体直径45米，中心标高272.5米，共9层，含旋转餐厅。太空厅中心标高342米，球体直径16米。

旋转餐厅位于267米高处，建筑面积1500平方米，是亚洲最高的旋转餐厅。

上海城市历史发展陈列馆位于塔座，通过80余个景点、数百件珍贵历史文物、上百幢按比例缩小的历史建筑、117个高仿蜡像反映了上海城市历史发展过程。

灯光系统由法国灯光设计师设计，可有1000多种变化。

开放时间：09:00-21:00。门票：观光门票199元/人。交通：乘坐公交81路、82路等至陆家嘴环路站。

sources.title: Oriental Pearl Tower Hours 2025-2026: Best Times to Visit
sources.content:
The Oriental Pearl Tower is open from 08:00-22:00 with admission stopping at 21:30. The Second Sphere combo ticket costs 199 RMB. Individual museum entry is 120 CNY per person.

Most visitors spend about 2–3 hours exploring the 263m main deck, 259m glass skywalk, 90m lower sphere, multimedia show, and the Shanghai History Museum. Dining or extras extend a full experience to 4 hours.

The Transparent Skywalk at 259 meters is made entirely of glass, giving the sensation of walking on air with the entire city visible beneath your feet.

sources.title: Oriental Pearl Tower, Shanghai's Iconic Landmark 2026
sources.content:
The Oriental Pearl Tower opened on October 1, 1994 and stands 468 meters tall. Completed in 1994, it symbolizes China's modernization and emergence on the global scene.

The tower combines urban sightseeing, fashion dining, shopping and entertainment, historical exhibits, river cruises, and broadcasting services. It was named one of Shanghai's ten new scenic attractions in 1995 and approved as a national AAAAA-level tourism attraction in 2007.

The tower reached its 100 millionth visitor on September 29, 2024.

The 259-meter Transparent Skywalk is made entirely of glass, offering the sensation of walking on air. The VR Roller Coaster at 95 meters combines virtual reality with adrenaline.

The Shanghai Urban History Development Museum at ground level features scaled-down architectural models, vivid wax figures, and rare artifacts documenting Shanghai's development.

Best visit time: Around 5 PM to enjoy both sunset and night lights.
